notes.postgres-billing.md:
# Decision: move billing to Postgres
We migrated the billing service off MySQL because we needed JSONB columns for invoice line items and partial indexes.
notes.kafka-retention.md:
# Kafka retention
Topic retention for the orders stream stays at seven days. Longer retention blew up broker disk usage last quarter.
notes.redis-sessions.txt: Session storage lives in Redis. Keys expire after thirty minutes of inactivity so abandoned logins clean themselves up.
notes.terraform-state.md:
# Terraform state
Remote state is kept in an S3 bucket with a DynamoDB table for locking, so two engineers can't apply at once.
notes.rust-borrow.md:
# Learning: Rust borrow checker
Most borrow checker errors I hit came from holding two mutable references to the same vector inside a loop.
notes.react-memo.md:
# Learning: React re-renders
Wrapping the chart component in React.memo stopped it from redrawing on every keystroke in the search box.
notes.docker-layers.md:
# Docker image size
Copying package.json before the source code lets the npm install layer stay cached, cutting builds from 6 minutes to 40 seconds.
notes.oncall-runbook.txt: When the payment webhook queue backs up, first check the dead-letter queue, then restart the consumer pods one at a time.
notes.api-versioning.md:
# Decision: API versioning
We version the public API in the URL path (/v2/) instead of headers because partners kept forgetting the header.
notes.jwt-expiry.md:
# Auth tokens
Access tokens last 15 minutes and refresh tokens 30 days. Short access tokens limit damage if one leaks.
notes.pytest-flaky.md:
# Flaky tests
The flaky integration tests were caused by tests sharing one database; giving each test its own transaction fixed it.
notes.cdn-cache.md:
# CDN caching
Static assets get a one-year cache with hashed filenames; HTML gets no-cache so deploys show up immediately.
notes.graphql-n-plus-1.md:
# Learning: GraphQL N+1
The slow orders query was making one database call per order. A DataLoader batched them into a single query.
notes.feature-flags.md:
# Decision: feature flags
All risky launches go behind a flag with a 5 percent rollout first, then 50, then everyone.
notes.s3-presigned.md:
# Uploads
Users upload straight to S3 with presigned URLs that expire after one hour, so files never pass through our servers.
notes.k8s-limits.md:
# Kubernetes memory
Pods kept getting OOMKilled until we set memory limits to match the JVM heap plus 25 percent overhead.
notes.monorepo.md:
# Decision: monorepo
We merged the web and mobile apps into one repo so shared types change in a single pull request.
notes.rate-limit.md:
# Rate limiting
The public API allows 100 requests per minute per key, enforced with a token bucket in Redis.
notes.backup-policy.txt: Database backups run nightly and are kept for 35 days. We test a restore on the first Monday of each month.
notes.typescript-strict.md:
# Learning: TypeScript strict mode
Turning on strictNullChecks found 40 places where we assumed an API field was always present.
